title: PART 1 / SET THE TABLE
goal: Activate prior knowledge about friendship and teamwork, build curiosity about the mystery, and introduce key mission vocabulary.
outcomes: Share prior knowledge and questions about friendship and teamwork.
Explain selected mission words using examples.
Make a prediction about the upcoming mystery.
prep_note: KWLS in the Core Workbook: one per student; pencils. If chosen: School Song or Party Planner sheet, one per student; Which Word Fits? uses one Our Vocabulary reference per group of 3–4. Mission Vocabulary needs no printing.
focus: Listen for accurate explanations and applications of mission vocabulary to teamwork.
assessment: Check whether students can explain a selected word and apply it to an example. For Which Word Fits?, listen as partners justify and revise choices.

rows.text: Slides 1–3 — Introduce Set the Table and “Team Switch Detected!”
How might you feel if a teammate switched teams without telling you?
Core Workbook KWLS: complete K with prior ideas and W with a question. Save L and S for Part 5.
What are you most curious to find out?
Students collect 10 words or phrases on the School Song sheet, then share and clarify selected words.
What do these words tell us about the school’s values?
Slide 5 — Introduce adaptability, communication, emotional regulation, and collaboration.
Review the definitions. Partners explain one skill in their own words and how it could help when a teammate unexpectedly changes groups.
Share a few examples. Watch for these skills when reading Chapter 1 in Part 2.
Slide 6 — Display the two scenarios and eight-word bank.
Students choose which word best describes each situation, then explain their reasons to a partner before checking definitions.
Our Vocabulary reference: one per group of 3–4 for checking and revising choices.
Partners invent another situation for a word to identify and explain. Circulate and listen for accurate explanations.
Party Planner sheet: one per student.
Partners choose six words, place them on the scale, and explain which three they would invite onto a strong team.
Share one new word, idea, or prediction.
